crossRefs.note: “Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.
“ ‘You shall rise up before the gray head and honor the face of the elderly; and you shall fear your God. I am Yahweh.
Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect…
Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of…
Don’t rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brothers;
Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.
Don’t receive an accusation against an elder, except at the word of two or three witnesses.
Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.
And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.

people.name: Japheth
people.line: Son of Noah, ancestor of Indo-European peoples

people.name: Shem
people.line: Noah's son, ancestor of Semitic peoples

translations.web: Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it on both their shoulders, went in backwards, and covered the nakedness of their father. Their faces were backwards, and they didn’t see their father’s nakedness.
translations.bsb: Then Shem and Japheth took a garment and placed it across their shoulders, and walking backward, they covered their father’s nakedness. Their faces were turned away so that they did not see their father’s nakedness.
translations.kjv: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces were backward, and they saw not their father's nakedness.
translations.asv: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father. And their faces were backward, and they saw not their father's nakedness.
